messages:
Dev (Design): quick sync 12: compact rollout list mock: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-rollouts. Goal: let engineers scan versions quickly, inline rollback without modal for normal ops, clear canary visualization, and strong keyboard behavior. Feedback?
Rae (PM): prefer inline rollback labeled with explicit version ("Rollback to v5.2"). add helper: "Undo available for 5m". Avoid accidental clicks.
Omar (Eng): two-step inline confirm (icon -> confirm) is cheap and reduces mistakes. for long lists use virtualization. we can emit an audit event on confirm. I'll prototype keyboard focus trap for the inline confirm.
Ivy (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) percent must remain in DOM (not hover-only), 2) keyboard focus order should be row -> timeline knob -> details -> rollback, 3) add aria-expanded on rows and aria-live="polite" for status updates. also fix contrast on muted legend (bot flagged it).
ui-bot: scan: muted legend (#8A9398 on #FFFFFF) fails contrast (2.6:1). suggested #42484B.
Dev (Design): great. I'll update figma to: explicit CTA text, inline confirm pattern, percent visible but subdued, and annotate keyboard flow. Will darken legend and add pattern overlay for canary bar.
Rae (PM): plan an A/B test for CTA phrasing: "Rollback to v{X}" vs "Revert service to v{X}". I'll open RED-1011.
Omar (Eng): will spike virtualization + focus-visible behavior and link PR here when ready.
Ivy (A11y): I'll re-run quick smoke after update. checklist: aria-expanded, aria-live, focus order, contrast.
Dev (Design): thanks everyone ":sparkles:" will post updated frames this afternoon."
